headline: Small ESE windswell on the prime angle — clean and offshore, log it early.
today: Prime ESE direction but the period's short at 4-5s, so you're looking at waist-high peelers, not much punch. Upside is the wind stays offshore N all day, so it's glassy dawn to dusk — no rush, just pick your tide. Grab the log or the groveler and enjoy a mellow home-break session; the incoming push toward the 3:15p high should have the most shape.

daysToWatch.note: Prime ESE angle again with a hair more period, but it's tiny and the wind swings onshore SSE hard by afternoon. Dawn is your only clean window.
Prime angle and size to nearly 3ft, but onshore S most of the day. Wind goes light in the evening if you want to gamble on a dusk cleanup.
